title: Saffron Pistachio Malai Kulfi Pops
hookLine: Dense, slow-creamed cardamom pistachio kulfi popsicles made in 10 mins with zero ice crystals.

items.name: Evaporated milk + condensed milk + heavy cream

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {milks_kf} and {spice_kf} and keep toppings like {pist_kf} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {pist_kf} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Whisk Milks, Pour into Molds & Freeze
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {milks_kf}, {spice_kf}, and {pist_kf} until frothy, pour into popsicle molds with wooden sticks, and freeze 5 hours until dense and creamy.
steps.creatorSecret: Condensed + evaporated milk prevents ice crystals completely without needing an ice cream maker.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze Saffron Pistachio Malai Kulfi Pops flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 6 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 10 mins.
